confirmed_findings: ray tracing must process nearer returns before farther returns on the same line of sight
rejected_recommendation: the grid boundary must not be reported as free distance when the forward corridor has no observed return; that would convert UNKNOWN into unsafe observed-free space
independent_audit.result: The confirmed ordering defect was fixed and covered by a regression test.

contracts: explicit self-body radial mask at 0.18 m
frontal corridor width is explicitly configured at 0.40 m
free_distance_m is the nearest valid forward corridor return
no in-grid frontal return yields conservative finite distance 0.0, UNKNOWN forward space and frontal_coverage_valid=false
complete records successful bounded processing independently of frontal coverage
free_distance_m walks centreline evidence to first OCCUPIED or UNKNOWN cell
unknown at or before the first observed-free cell yields zero conservative clearance
out-of-grid returns do not certify forward coverage
nearer returns are processed before farther returns on the same line of sight
ray tracing marks only cells before a first hit as OBSERVED_FREE
cells behind a hit are never cleared
occupied returns are retained independently of semantic identity
payload dimensions, states and arrays are validated and copied

fixtures: side and reverse returns excluded from frontal metric
nearest frontal obstacle reported at 1.50 m
invalid shape, nonfinite input and point-count bound rejection
coverage state and snapshot structural validation
limitations: The z limits and self radius are development profile values, not physical calibration.
The implementation expects deskewed, extrinsically normalized local points.
Ray traversal is bounded local-grid evidence, not a complete persistent occupancy mapper.
No physical or replay sensor coverage is inferred from synthetic fixtures.
